cues.zh: 看看这支铅笔。世界上没有一个人能独自造出它。
cues.en: Look at this lead pencil. There's not a single person in the world who could make this pencil.

cues.zh: 这话很惊人？一点也不！
cues.en: Remarkable statement? Not at all!

cues.zh: 据我所知，做它的木头来自华盛顿州砍倒的一棵树。
cues.en: The wood from which it's made, for all I know, comes from a tree that was cut down in the state of Washington.

cues.zh: 砍那棵树需要锯子。造锯子需要钢。炼钢需要铁矿石。
cues.en: To cut down that tree, it took a saw. To make the saw, it took steel. To make the steel it took iron ore.

cues.zh: 这个黑色的芯。我们叫它铅，但其实是石墨，压缩石墨。
cues.en: This black center. We call it lead, but it's really graphite, compressed graphite.

cues.zh: 我不确定它来自哪里，但我想是南美的一些矿场。
cues.en: I'm not sure where it comes from, but I think it comes from some mines in South America.

cues.zh: 顶上这块红色的橡皮，苦味橡胶，可能来自马来亚，
cues.en: This red top up here, the eraser, bitter rubber, probably comes from Malaya,

cues.zh: 而那里的橡胶树甚至不是原生的，是某些商人从南美引进的，
cues.en: where the rubber tree isn't even native it was imported from South America by some businessmen,

cues.zh: 在英国政府的帮助下。
cues.en: with the help of the British government.

cues.zh: 这个黄铜箍——
cues.en: This brass ferrule -

cues.zh: 我完全不知道它从哪来，
cues.en: I haven't the slightest idea where it came from,

cues.zh: 还有那黄漆，画黑线的漆，以及把它粘在一起的胶水。
cues.en: Or the yellow paint, or the paint that made the black lines, or the glue that holds it together.

cues.zh: 成千上万的人合作才造出这支铅笔。
cues.en: Literally thousands of people cooperated to make this pencil.

cues.zh: 这些人语言不通，信仰不同，若真见了面，说不定还会彼此憎恨。
cues.en: People who don't speak the same language, who practice different religions, who might hate one another if they ever met.

cues.zh: 当你去商店买这支铅笔时，
cues.en: When you go down the store and buy this pencil,

cues.zh: 实际上是用你几分钟的时间，交换那成千上万人几秒钟的时间。
cues.en: you are in effect trading a few minutes of your time for a few seconds of the time of all those thousands of people.

cues.zh: 是什么把他们聚在一起，促使他们合作造出这支铅笔？
cues.en: What brought them together and induced them to cooperate to make this pencil?

cues.zh: 没有政委从某个中央办公室发号施令。
cues.en: There was no commissar sending out officers from sending out orders from some central office.

cues.zh: 这是价格体系的魔法。
cues.en: It was a magic of the price system.

cues.zh: 价格那种非人格化的运作，把他们聚到一起，让他们合作造出这支铅笔。
cues.en: The impersonal operation of prices that brought them together and got them to cooperate to make this pencil.

cues.zh: 好让你花一点点钱就能拥有它。
cues.en: So that you could have it for a trifling sum.

cues.zh: 正因如此，自由市场的运作才如此不可或缺，不仅是为了提升生产效率，更是——
cues.en: That is why the operation of the free Market is so essential not only to promote productive efficiency, but even more -

cues.zh: 为了促进世界各国人民之间的和谐与和平。
cues.en: to foster harmony and peace among the peoples of the world.
